say:5:1064104002:0.text: Wh-Who are you? Don't hurt my Mom!
say:5:1064104002:0.source_cn: 你、你是谁？！你要对我妈妈做什么？！

say:6:1064104003:0.text: Every dark magic wielder needs to be purged.
say:6:1064104003:0.source_cn: 操纵黑魔法的恶徒，必须受到裁决。

say:8:1064104005:1.text: No! My mom's not a bad guy! You're mistaken!
say:8:1064104005:1.source_cn: 不可能！我妈妈才不是坏人！一定是你搞错了！

say:9:1064104006:0.text: And... I don't even know who you are! You're lying!
say:9:1064104006:0.source_cn: 而且……而且你不是恩莎村的人！一定是你在撒谎！

say:11:1064104007:1.source_cn: 艾、艾雅在上……阿塔利娅大人，总算跟上您了！

say:12:1064104008:1.text: Lady Athalia, why her? Eminie is Lero's wife. She's a victim!
say:12:1064104008:1.source_cn: ……您、您为什么要拿武器对准埃米妮？她是列罗的妻子，是...

say:13:1064104009:1.text: The dark magic on his body was her doing.
say:13:1064104009:1.source_cn: 尸体上的黑魔法，是她施加的。

say:14:1064104010:1.text: She has fallen into darkness. A purge is pending.
say:14:1064104010:1.source_cn: 她已堕入邪恶，必须清除。

say:15:1064104011:1.text: Forgive me, Lady Athalia, but that can't be true! Eminie is innocent. Something doesn't add up.
say:15:1064104011:1.source_cn: 黑魔法？不，阿塔利娅大人，埃米妮只是一个无辜的普通人，...

say:16:1064104012:1.text: There is no innocence in the Adamant Syndicate! All who bear its name profane the Goddess.
say:16:1064104012:1.source_cn: 黑金成员全都是亵渎女神的邪恶之徒！何来无辜？！

say:17:1064104013:1.text: Their sins are unforgivable! Only judgment preserves justice!
say:17:1064104013:1.source_cn: 他们犯下的罪行不可饶恕！唯有裁决才可维持正义！

say:18:1064104014:1.text: B-But Eminie can't be one of them! After the war, she hardly ever even left Ensar!
say:18:1064104014:1.source_cn: 黑金商会？可是……可是埃米妮不可能是他们的成员啊！战争...

say:19:1064104015:0.source_cn: 埃米妮，你快向阿塔利娅大人解释一下！

say:22:1064104017:0.text: She is right... It's all my fault...
say:22:1064104017:0.source_cn: 不，她说的没错……所有一切，都是因为我的错……

say:23:1064104018:0.text: I did too much wrong when I was young. And now Lero's death is my price to pay...
say:23:1064104018:0.source_cn: 如果不是我年轻时犯下了那么多罪，我的家人也不会遭到如今...

say:25:1064104019:0.text: Confession changes nothing. Submit to judgment and pay what you owe.
say:25:1064104019:0.source_cn: 你既已认罪，就接受裁决，偿还你的罪孽。

say:26:1064104020:1.text: That's the final mercy from Dura!
say:26:1064104020:1.source_cn: 这是女神恩赐给你的，最后的怜悯——

say:30:1064104022:1.text: Louisa? Careful—your legs... Why did you come running?
say:30:1064104022:1.source_cn: 路易莎修女？！你腿脚不便，怎么还是赶过来了？

say:32:1064104023:1.text: Please hear me out, Lady Athalia. Eminie did join the Adamant Syndicate once, but she did it to survive.
say:32:1064104023:1.source_cn: 尊敬的阿塔利娅大人，请听我一言：埃米妮确实曾加入过黑金...

say:33:1064104024:0.text: During the Second Divine War more than a decade ago, Ensar was hit by brutal Hypofiend raids. Supplies ran dry...
say:33:1064104024:0.source_cn: 十几年前，第二次神魔大战期间，恩莎村遭受了魔物的猛烈攻...

say:34:1064104025:1.text: The Adamant Syndicate was the only one that could get us food and necessities. But they charged a fortune. People sold off their homes and still couldn't buy enough to last.
say:34:1064104025:1.source_cn: 在那样的情况下，能为我们提供粮食和生活物资的只有黑金商...

say:35:1064104026:1.text: Without Eminie taking that risk and finding us ways to make money, Ensar would've been wiped off the map long ago...
say:35:1064104026:1.source_cn: 如果不是埃米妮冒险加入黑金商会，帮大家寻找赚钱的机会，...

say:36:1064104027:1.text: Yes, she's guilty of wrongs. But she's no monster, Lady Athalia.
say:36:1064104027:1.source_cn: 我不会否认埃米妮曾犯下过种种罪孽，但恳求您相信，她绝非...

say:37:1064104028:0.text: She cut ties with the Adamant Syndicate once the war ended. She started a family with Lero and barely left the village for fear of bringing danger to them.
say:37:1064104028:0.source_cn: 而且，战争结束后埃米妮便与黑金彻底断绝了来往。和列罗结...

say:40:1064104030:0.text: Lady Athalia... I'm begging you. She broke free from the Adamant Syndicate years ago. For that alone, please show her mercy.
say:40:1064104030:0.source_cn: 尊敬的阿塔利娅大人，我恳求您，看在她早已脱离黑金的份上...

say:41:1064104031:0.text: Yet, she still uses dark magic!

say:42:1064104032:1.text: They loved each other deeply, so his death came as a great shock. She tried to revive him with a dark magic potion the Syndicate once gave her.
say:42:1064104032:1.source_cn: 埃米妮与列罗感情甚笃，她只是一时无法接受列罗的离去，才...

say:43:1064104033:1.text: Besides, the potion failed. That alone proves she has no ties to the Adamant Syndicate.
say:43:1064104033:1.source_cn: 可是您看，黑魔法药剂并没有生效，这足以说明埃米妮和黑金...

say:44:1064104034:1.source_cn: 我再次恳求您——请您宽恕埃米妮的罪孽！

say:46:1064104036:1.text: Dura withdrew from this world only ten short years ago and already mortals have forgotten. Forgotten that the Syndicate conspired with the Hypogeans who waged the war.
say:46:1064104036:1.source_cn: 艾雅女神不再降临于世不过短短十年，凡人便忘却了当年的仇...

say:47:1064104037:1.text: This is blasphemy. Betrayal! It will not be forgiven.
say:47:1064104037:1.source_cn: ——这是对女神的亵渎与背叛！绝不可原谅！

say:48:1064104038:1.text: And you, who serves the Goddess, should not lend your voice to shield the guilty.
say:48:1064104038:1.source_cn: 你身为侍奉女神的修女，亦不该为罪人发言！

say:53:1064104041:1.text: N-No...! No one's going to hurt my mom! Not even Lady Athalia! *Crying*
say:53:1064104041:1.source_cn: 不，不行……谁也不能伤害我妈妈！就算是传说中的阿塔利娅...

say:55:1064104042:1.text: Lady Athalia, please don't! It goes against the Temple's creed!
say:55:1064104042:1.source_cn: ……阿塔利娅大人，您不能这样做！这有违圣堂的教义！

say:56:1064104043:1.text: To purge evil and uphold justice. That is exactly Dura's words!
say:56:1064104043:1.source_cn: 裁决邪恶，维护正义——这正是艾雅女神示下神谕！

say:57:1064104044:1.text: The words are for you and the other Celestials. But the Temple was built on something else.
say:57:1064104044:1.source_cn: 这是艾雅女神传达给您和诸位半神的神谕，但圣堂最重要的教...

say:58:1064104045:1.text: The Goddess raised the Temple to shelter mortals in suffering.
say:58:1064104045:1.source_cn: 女神建立圣堂，是为了给遭遇苦难的凡人提供庇护。

say:59:1064104046:1.text: Not only for refugees who lost everything to war... but for people like Eminie, too—people pushed onto the wrong path.
say:59:1064104046:1.source_cn: 这些人里，不止因为战争而失去亲人、流离失所的难民……也...

say:60:1064104047:1.text: You're right. The Adamant Syndicate has committed blasphemy, and Eminie is no exception. But it's also true she brought supplies to Ensar and that's what kept the Temple running, so we could protect more lives!
say:60:1064104047:1.source_cn: 如您所说，黑金成员都做过亵渎女神之事，埃米妮也不例外。...

say:61:1064104048:1.text: The Divine War tore the land apart. As a refugee, I was rejected by most of the towns, which struggled to even protect themselves...
say:61:1064104048:1.source_cn: 十年前大地上炮火连天，我逃难时路过了许多村镇，其中绝大...

say:62:1064104049:1.text: Only Ensar, and the temple here, took in refugees like me. They gave us food, blankets, and a place to sleep.
say:62:1064104049:1.source_cn: 只有恩莎村，只有这里的教堂，收留了很多像我这样的难民，...

say:63:1064104050:1.text: I believe Eminie had a hand in that. Louisa said it herself. Without Eminie, Ensar might not have held on until the war ended.
say:63:1064104050:1.source_cn: 我想，这其中一定有埃米妮的功劳！路易莎修女也说过，如果...

say:64:1064104051:1.text: And for the ten years after that, she gave what she could to every temple effort.
say:64:1064104051:1.source_cn: 而且战争结束后的十年里，埃米妮一直非常虔诚，不论教堂举...

say:65:1064104052:1.text: She always remains a devotee of Dura. She chose to save more people, even if it meant going against what she believed and walking beside the Adamant Syndicate.
say:65:1064104052:1.source_cn: 她对女神的信仰从未改变，只是为了遵从圣堂的教义、拯救更...

say:66:1064104053:1.text: To me... that's an act of kindness and a sacrifice, too. One that tears at the soul. Otherwise, she wouldn't have carried this guilt until today.
say:66:1064104053:1.source_cn: 在我看来……这同样是一种牺牲，一种内心饱受煎熬的牺牲。...

say:69:1064104055:1.text: L-Lady Athalia! I don't know if my mom did bad things before... but she never betrayed Dura!
say:69:1064104055:1.source_cn: 阿、阿塔利娅大人，我不知道我妈妈有没有做过坏事……但是...

say:70:1064104056:1.text: Mom always told me to follow the acolytes' example and serve Dura wholeheartedly!
say:70:1064104056:1.source_cn: 妈妈一直教导我，要我跟着修士修女们多多学习，好好侍奉女神。

say:71:1064104057:1.text: Whenever I made a mistake, no matter how small, she'd send me to the temple to confess and ask Dura for forgiveness...
say:71:1064104057:1.source_cn: 每次我犯了错，就算只是不小心害朋友划伤了手，她都会要求...

say:72:1064104058:1.text: My mom... She's really a good person...
say:72:1064104058:1.source_cn: 我妈妈，她真的不是坏人……

say:73:1064104059:1.text: P-Please forgive her... I'll confess to Dura every day... *Sobbing*
say:73:1064104059:1.source_cn: 求求您，原谅她，我会每天都向女神忏悔的……呜呜呜呜……

say:74:1064104060:1.text: No, Kirako. My poor child. It's all Mom's fault.
say:74:1064104060:1.source_cn: 不……吉拉科，我可怜的孩子……都是妈妈的错……

say:75:1064104061:1.text: Remember what I said? You need to take the consequences of your actions... Mom did a lot of bad things. It's time to pay the price...
say:75:1064104061:1.source_cn: 还记得妈妈曾经教过你的吗？做错了事就要承担后果……妈妈...

say:76:1064104062:1.text: I will grant you three chances.

say:77:1064104063:1.text: One for serving the Adamant Syndicate. One for using dark magic.
say:77:1064104063:1.source_cn: 为黑金效力，第一次。使用黑魔法，第二次。

say:78:1064104064:1.text: Should there be a third, judgment will fall.
say:78:1064104064:1.source_cn: 若再有下一次，裁决必将降临。

say:79:1064104065:1.source_cn: 您……您愿意宽恕我的罪孽……？

say:80:1064104066:1.text: You have not taken a life. You aided the Temple. A cruel war that drove mortals to desperate acts.
say:80:1064104066:1.source_cn: 你没有杀过人。你帮助了圣堂。战争很残酷，凡人过得艰难。

say:82:1064104068:1.text: Those like you may be forgiven three times.
say:82:1064104068:1.source_cn: 和你相像的人，犯错不超过三次，可以宽恕。

say:84:1064104069:1.text: Lady Athalia, maybe we should take every individual circumstance into account.
say:84:1064104069:1.source_cn: 阿塔利娅大人，每个人的情况都不同，或许不能这样算……

say:85:1064104070:1.text: I have no time to hear every villain's tale and decide whether their suffering excuses their sin.
say:85:1064104070:1.source_cn: 我没有时间听完每个恶徒的故事，无法判断他们有无苦衷。

say:86:1064104071:1.text: To me, evil must be purged. Three chances are a rare generosity.
say:86:1064104071:1.source_cn: 在我看来，每个恶徒都该受到裁决，无论罪行多少。三次机会...

say:90:1064104074:1.text: Sorry, but I have to finish, Louisa.
say:90:1064104074:1.source_cn: ……抱歉，路易莎修女，我必须说完。

say:92:1064104075:1.text: I have a proposal that may help you, Lady Athalia.
say:92:1064104075:1.source_cn: 阿塔利娅大人，我有一个提议，也许能够帮到您。

say:93:1064104076:1.text: Have a few faithful followers at your side and let their counsel guide your verdicts. That way, you can consider every angle and act with true fairness.
say:93:1064104076:1.source_cn: 如果您能将一些忠诚于女神的信徒带在身边，以他们的意见作...

say:94:1064104077:1.text: With their help, your hunt for evil would be swifter and far more effective.
say:94:1064104077:1.source_cn: 有了他们的协助，铲除邪恶之徒的行动也能事半功倍。

say:97:1064104080:1.text: Dura above. Thank you for your mercy and grace.
say:97:1064104080:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……感恩您的宽容与仁慈！
